plugin.name: Peter Jackson's King Kong Widescreen Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Use auto for the display aspect ratio, or enter positive dimensions such as 16:9.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
RawInputMouse.description: Use raw mouse input for camera movement. Needs a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Culling follows the camera.
WindowedMode.description: Run the game in a borderless window.
DisableBlur.description: Disable supported blur shaders and correct the obscured damage overlay on Direct3D 9.
VSync.description: Synchronize Direct3D 9 presentation to the display refresh rate.
FPSLimit.description: 0 is unlimited; -1 follows the monitor refresh rate. Changes apply while playing. Two affected levels use 30 FPS while limiting is enabled. Rates above 60 can break gameplay.
FPSLimitMode.description: Use 1 for a busy wait or 2 for a sleep and yield limiter.
HideUntexturedObjects.description: Gamer's Edition only: 0 keeps all objects, 1 hides fewer broken objects, and 2 hides more.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the native fix menu language. Auto uses a supported detected language, or English when detection or translation is unavailable. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Keep the original aspect with black borders, crop to fill the screen, or stretch. Applies immediately.
MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplier on the game’s mouse sensitivity. Changes apply while playing when raw input is enabled.
